query: I have a 62-year-old woman; among female patients aged 57–67, what's the minimum distinct valve repair/replacement procedures per hospitalization?
final_sql: SELECT MIN(COUNT(DISTINCT p.procedure_id)) AS min_procedures FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dob) = 1962 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.dischtime) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND p.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 57 AND 67 AND p.anchor_year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 57 AND 67 AND p.dod IS NULL AND p.race = 'White' AND p.marital_status = 'Married' AND p.language = 'English' AND p.edregtime BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND p.edouttime BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND p.hospital_expire_flag = 'N';
